title: TechTriview

content:

title: Security Rule Engine

content:
# Security Rule Engine - Network Security System

A comprehensive network security solution that provides real-time packet monitoring and analysis capabilities.

title: Formidium Invoice System

content:
# Formidium Invoice System - Crypto Payment Platform

A cutting-edge cryptocurrency invoice management system that simplifies crypto payments for businesses and individuals.

title: Madhyam
description: Developed the backend and integrated AI for a real-time sign language translator, securing a Top 5 position in HackJKLU 2. Managed AI model interactions, backend workflows, and real-time communication via WebSockets.
content:
# Madhyam - Breaking Communication Barriers

Madhyam is an AI-powered platform designed to break communication barriers by providing comprehensive sign language translation and audio conversion tools.
